newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec shares fuelled by Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec shares fuelled by Q1 profit.

text.p: Shares in oil and gas producer Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd gained 17 cents or 3.5 percent to A$5.30, on modest volume, after the release of its first quarter results, brokers said.
The company reported a profit after tax, including non-recurring profits on the sale of assets, of A$12.6 million for the three months to September 30, 1996.
"They have had some profit figures out this morning so its most likely on the back of that," said a Sydney broker, noting that volume was not at high levels.
"The volume is not spectacular with only 55,000 or so shares going through. They see probably see more action in the U.S."
The profit result was the company's first since it listed its American Depositary Shares (ADS) on the NASDAQ market in July 1996. Each ADS represents five ordinary shares.
PetSec raised about A$84 million through the ADS issue to fund its reconstruction as a pure oil and gas play and its exploration and development activities in the Gulf of Mexico.
By 3.20 p.m. (0420 GMT), PetSec shares were holding at A$5.30 on turnover of 67,272 shares.
